items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: We were all in Oliver Todd's band. And instead of usin' a drummer in Oliver Todd's band, we had a guy who would sing with the band sometime. That was Bill Nolan. And we put Countess on the thing-- : Bill Nolan -- he went with McShann too Chantue (phonetic), didn't he? ... We had Piggy Minor (phoneti

ctx.x: things. And we had some gigs, you know And then the male singer left, and we got the girl singer, in Oliver Todd's group there. And somehow, he got an old alto player named Charlie Green, who had been in Clarence Love's band. And almost overnight, Charlie Green stole the band from Oliver Todd. We stayed with the band maybe a couple of weeks. So five of us just decided, since we're doing this-- by this time, it had become, like in '35, you know.
And we went out and got a job at this club on 12th Street.
